item.title: Kiritanpo Nabe: Akita's Iconic Rice Hot Pot — Guide
item.description: Kiritanpo is Akita’s most iconic dish — freshly pounded rice is moulded onto cedar skewers, grilled over charcoal, then simmered in a rich broth with Hinai-jidori chicken (one of Japan’s three great chickens), burdock, Japanese parsley and maitake mushrooms. The mochi-like kiritanpo soaks up the umami broth beautifully. Best from October to March. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Akita City & Odate, Akita Hours Restaurant hours Admission ~¥1,200–2,000 a set Time needed About 1 hour Best time Oct–Mar (winter) What to Try Grilled kiritanpo rice skewers in a rich hot pot.
